title: Result of inbox.list
description: Request args: {"after"?, "limit"?}. What the manager's copy holds above `after` (default: its acknowledged mark), oldest first. A read takes nothing, from this copy or from the native queue. A seq counts within one boot.

received.description: Receptions this boot; the highest seq so far.

lost.description: Receptions this boot pushed out unread, or received before there were slots.

more.description: More is held above the last entry: read again with after set to its seq.

from.description: Direct only: the stored contact whose shared key opened it.

channel.description: Channel only: the slot whose key opened it. Anyone holding that key could have sent it; a sender's name in the text is only a claim.

signer.description: Type signed only: the key prefix the native frame carries.

cut.description: The text was longer than 160 bytes and this is its start. Absent otherwise.

ts.description: The sender's own claim of the time, never checked.

rx_ts.description: This device's clock at reception. On a board without a battery clock it may be a default the clock started from rather than a time anyone set.

age_s.description: Seconds since reception, by uptime: needs no clock.

hash.description: The native packet hash: the same id a sender or an observer computes.

snr_x4.description: As the native frame carries it.

path_len.description: Route flood only: as the native frame carries it.
